name: Logitech M557 (Bluetooth)
notes: 246-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Logitech M557, from hidapi's Windows test data for the device: https://github.com/libusb/hidapi/blob/852cc68b8e0e4c7eba0815ef992951cd8b75c55b/windows/test/data/046D_B010_0002_0001_real.rpt_desc#L7-L22. Bluetooth, so the descriptor is the device's whole HID report map. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
